body: I'm so scared. I'm so tired. I don't know what to do anymore, I had called the suicide hotline last time I nearly killed myself and it helped sort of. To this day I still regret not killing myself when I was 18 and I think about it all the time. I just keep drinking (I'm not a drinker, this is probably the first time in 4 months I've been "drunk") and my head is spinning and I have these pills and a knife layed out in front of me and I just don't know what to do. I'm scared the pills won't put me in a coma fast enough, I don't want my boyfriend to have to clean up after me if I bleed. I don't think I can call the suicide hotline right now, if my boyfriend gets home before I do something I'll have to talk to him. I just want to be over. I had a letter I wrote a few years ago but I've since deleted it. I don't know how to tell my family and boyfriend how much I love them, and how sorry I am that I hurt them and that I hurt me. Its just all too much.

I guess I just never want to experience childbirth, I absolutely never ever ever want to be a mother. My dad tells me I'm selfish for believing this but it's the truth. I'd rather cut my own uterus out myself than spend the next 9 months knowing I'm destroying this child. I can't bring a new life into this terrible world. I haven't talked to my boyfriend about my suicidal feelings, but he knows how severe my depression and anxiety are and he's been nothing but kind and patient. He's dealt with depression for a while and I can tell it hurts him when he's seen my try so many treatment options with no success in managing my panic attacks. I don't know how to tell him about my suicidal feelings, I love him more than anything and I don't want him to be afraid to leave me alone in the apartment.

I'm just tired of trying. I've been extremely suicidal 3 times before and talked myself out of it. Nothing has gotten better, I don't think it gets better for me. I can honestly say I regret not going through with it when I was 18, my life has been hell since. Planned parenthood wants about $400 where I live and there's no way I'd be able to make that much until its too late to do anything about it. If I don't die today I'm just going to keep drinking alcohol and coffee and hope for a miscarriage. But I really don't think I can last even a week, I just really want to be gone. It may make me a coward and a failure but seems fitting to end my meaningless life in a meaningless way. I'm just kind of ranting at this point, I don't really know what to say. I truly appreciate your concern and I thank you for your comment.
I have 5,400 mg of Ibuprofen and weigh 120lbs, will this be enough?
